groups.rule: Saved official LoCoMo scorer: category1 f1, categories2-4 f1_score; category3 gold first semicolon segment.

interpretation.scope: 仅完整同题交集；探索性 pilot，不代表完整基准。
interpretation.averaging: 每个数据集、VikingJev 有效版本与协议分别按题等权汇总；无跨版本或跨数据集总均值。
interpretation.baseline_provenance: 继承成绩归属原始有效版本与原始 run；容器 run 不改变实验协议。历史未保存的协议哈希标为 unknown。
interpretation.inference: 仅描述已保存分数；未计算显著性或泛化优势，N=1 仅记录该题表现。

cost_background.scope: 全部历史实验的预算账，不是本表可比题目的成本；共享建库费用不按题均摊，缓存继承不重复记账。
cost_background.reservation_meaning: 未结算预留包括费用未知和在途请求；不是已确认扣款。账户可用余额未知。

snapshot.consistency: Fixed complete JSONL prefix; a live run may append after this cutoff. Summary is read later and may be newer.

original_pilot.policy: type stratification and seeded source-index sampling; no answer/performance selection

locomo20.selection: All20 already fixed original-pilot LoCoMo questions from conv-41/conv-26; all three saved baselines available; only ours resumed.
locomo20.bias: Two conversations, development exposure, retained resumable prefixes and successful baseline coverage; exploratory subset.

lme3_preselected_stage.selection_rule: Sort ascending remaining ingestion units, remaining source tokens, full history source tokens, then stable ID; take three. This also covers all three observed categories. No answers or model scores enter the algorithm.
lme3_preselected_stage.selection_bias: Already-completed baseline intersection and cheaper/resumable histories; exploratory convenience subset, not representative or sufficient for significance/general superiority.

recovery_conditioning.bias: Failure-selected repair histories; reporting only valid same-question intersections also conditions on successful completion.

optional_fact_text_v4_recovery.conditioning: Recovery-conditioned single question with inherited source-ID set/optional-text normalization and manual selected-source review of chosen paid extraction responses, independent of QA answers/scores.

metric_provenance.locomo: Official AST functions normalize_answer, f1_score, f1; PorterStemmer; category 3 semicolon prefix
metric_provenance.longmemeval: Official get_anscheck_prompt; exact yes/no validation; no substring acceptance
